label: Brand gallery
title: Blue, yellow and a torn ticket
lede: The identity barely changed in twenty-five years: yellow block capitals on a blue ticket stub with a ragged edge. Here it is on a membership card, on the stores and on the website, with our drawings in the same spirit.

drawings.title: The store.
drawings.caption: A strip-mall video store at night. Original illustration, not an official asset.

drawings.title: The product.
drawings.caption: A rental cassette with a reminder to rewind. Before 1998 a major release cost the chain $60 to $70 a copy.[^1] Original illustration.

drawings.title: The profit.
drawings.caption: The after-hours return box, and the receipt for bringing it back late. Extended viewing fees were $692.6M in 1999.[^2] Original illustration.

drawings.title: The replacement.
drawings.caption: A disc in an envelope. Original illustration.

disclaimer: Colours are approximations sampled from archived captures and photographs[^33]. Blockbuster and the torn-ticket design are trademarks of their owner and appear here in historical and editorial context. Drawings are original illustrations and do not reproduce the logo.
